evals.name: frog-hop-loop
evals.prompt: make me a 4 second seamless loop, square 1080: a little voxel frog sits on a lily pad floating in a tiny round pond on a wooden plinth. its cheeks puff before it does one big hop straight up, then it lands back on the pad with a splash (ripples + a few droplets). soft warm morning light from the left, cool rim from behind. gentle plucky synth score in G major with a boing on the landing. mix to -14 LUFS
evals.expected_output: 1080x1080 60 fps 4 s seamless-loop MP4 with muxed 48 kHz stereo score at -14 LUFS, single three.js HTML source, beat sheet
assertions: An MP4 was delivered
Resolution matches the brief
60 fps with the requested duration (+-1 frame)
Audio is muxed in: 48 kHz stereo
Integrated loudness is -14 LUFS (+-1)
True peak is at or below -1.0 dBTP
A single-file three.js HTML source was delivered
Randomness is seeded (no Math.random in the source)
A frame-level plan (beat sheet) was written
Notes report measurements and judgment calls
Loop seam: the last frame flows into the first like any other step
